title: QNHS: Quantum-Neuromorphic Hybrid Substrate simulation suite
description: Open simulation code, unit tests, extended experiment results and a hardware security threat model for a quantum-neuromorphic hybrid substrate: energy with cooling cost and Monte Carlo uncertainty, Q-STDP learning, density-matrix simulation of amplitude re-preparation under noise, spiking-network learning, MTJ device and surface-code coherence models, and spike-timing poisoning analysis.
